why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://promotions.beldex.io   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Beldex promotions site Go to the Beldex airdrop page and choose to earn credits.
2 Step 2 : Link your X account Connect your X account on the promotions site, which is how you register for the airdrop.
3 Step 3 : Post about Beldex on X Post replies, quote posts or original posts that name @Beldexcoin and include #Beldex. Each kind of post is scored with its own multiplier.

4 Step 4 : Check the Loyalty Program Open the Beldex quest site to see the Loyalty Program, where Beldex Points lead to the leaderboard and airdrop eligibility. Connecting a wallet there lets you view your points and rewards history.
5 Step 5 : Claim after the airdrop event When the airdrop event ends, open the dashboard to collect your share of the BDX.
